financial_information.funding_stage_corrected_reason: Was 'acquired' — that status belongs to 'Be Applied Limited' (beapplied.com, a UK recruiting-software company acquired by Phenom), not Applied Intuition. Applied Intuition is an independent company; its latest and most recent round is a $600M Series F closed June 17 2025 at a $15B valuation (co-led by BlackRock and Kleiner Perkins), per the company's own press release.

provenance.location_mapping[22].location_source_que: Applied office Fort Walton Beach Florida
provenance.location_mapping[23].location_source_not: 3 job postings (Perception & Fusion Engineer x2, Senior C++ Software Engineer - Defense Air) list 'Freeport, USA' as their location. Web search found no press release or filing for a distinct Applied Intuition facility in Freeport, FL — the company's only confirmed Florida Panhandle office is Fort Walton Beach (opened Jan 2026). Freeport is a real small city in Walton County, ~10-15 miles from Fort Walton Beach, in the same Eglin Air Force Base defense-industry corridor that Applied Intuition's Defense Air roles serve. Added as its own location entry using Freeport city-center coordinates (rather than merging into fort_walton_beach_office) since the job postings themselves distinguish the two cities and no exact street address could be confirmed for either interpretation.
